stage.name: Undercurrent Nest
stage.description:
The lab's beacon has detected disrupted currents. Seaborns pour forth from the nest, threatening to overwhelm the entire ocean basin. Dive into the abyss and restore the proper flow!
<Condition> DP will not regenerate naturally.
<Excrescent Carapace> Deployable for High Ground Operators.
<Waterway Beacon> Must be charged by a High Ground Operator; allows your units to deal Burn when activated.
<Little Handy> Removes <Excrescent Carapace> and <Nethersea Brand>.

allotropic_predator.name: Allotropic Predator
allotropic_predator.flavourText: Simple but nourished, this new generation of Seaborn collects nutrients even more efficiently.

nourished_runner.name: Nourished Runner
nourished_runner.flavourText: A Sea Terror that grew four limbs and has sated its hunger. It controls its body's movements using hydraulic pressure and possesses superior reflexes.

allotropic_drifter.name: Allotropic Drifter
allotropic_drifter.flavourText: A Seaborn nourished in the migration process, possessing more energy for evolution or self-protection.
abilities: Flying unit.
Prioritizes units on High Ground.
Attacks inflict Nervous Impairment.

unicellular_predator.name: Unicellular Predator
unicellular_predator.flavourText: A simple Seaborn believed to be responsible for foraging. It requires very little energy for its activities.

shell_sea_runner.name: Shell Sea Runner
shell_sea_runner.flavourText: A Sea Terror that grew four limbs, but lacks an internal skeleton. It seems to have once hunted quadrupeds on land.

allotropic_nurse.name: Allotropic Nurse
allotropic_nurse.flavourText: A complex Seaborn that has nurtured countless broods. Its specialized organs have developed into esoteric shapes. Its core is concealed even deeper, and the Seaborn it fosters are even more dangerous.
abilities: On death, randomly releases an <Allotropic Hoarder>, <Allotropic Predator>, or <Exocellular Depositor> with increased Movement Speed.

allotropic_hoarder.name: Allotropic Hoarder
allotropic_hoarder.flavourText: A Divicellular Hoarder that has stockpiled excessive nutrients, capable of responding to intense stimuli.
abilities: Splits when HP drops below 50% for the first time.

divicellular_hoarder.name: Divicellular Hoarder
divicellular_hoarder.flavourText: A Seaborn highly attuned to its environment, believed to be responsible for stockpiling resources. May split at any time when under stress.
abilities: Splits when HP drops below 50% for the first time.

exocellular_depositor.name: Exocellular Depositor
exocellular_depositor.flavourText: A simple Seaborn that accumulates a large amount of chitin to form an excrescent carapace.
abilities: Spawns an Excrescent Carapace at its location when defeated.
More likely to be attacked by allied units

matrocellular_nurse.name: Matrocellular Nurse
matrocellular_nurse.flavourText: A complex Seaborn with a variety of organs, believed to be responsible for brood care. Its core is concealed within its body.
abilities: On death, randomly releases a <Divicellular Hoarder>, <Unicellular Predator>, or <Exocellular Depositor> with increased Movement Speed.

toxocellular_drifter.name: Toxocellular Drifter
toxocellular_drifter.flavourText: A Seaborn with a highly developed cytostome, believed to be responsible for transportation. Shoots venomous cilia to protect itself.
abilities: Flying unit.
Prioritizes units on High Ground.
Attacks inflict Nervous Impairment.

multicellular_herald.name: Multicellular Herald
multicellular_herald.flavourText: Highly differentiated Seaborn with specialized tentacles that have proliferated across the ocean. Numbering in the billions, they are believed to shape ocean currents when they wave their tentacles.
abilities: Can devour an Excrescent Carapace to significantly increase its ATK and HP.

nucleic_maleficent.name: Nucleic Maleficent
nucleic_maleficent.flavourText: A cell originally meant to develop into a specialized organ has mutated into an individual entity capable of metabolizing body waste into neurotoxin. Its role within the Seaborn population remains unclear.
abilities: Becomes Combat-Ready when damaged, significantly increasing Movement Speed and continuously inflicting Nervous Impairment on nearby units.
Destroys blocking <Excrescent Carapace> at the cost of a percentage of its HP.

allotropic_herald.name: Allotropic Herald
allotropic_herald.flavourText: Seaborn that have grown in nutrient-rich environments. In sufficient numbers, they can influence tidal movements and even trigger tsunamis.
abilities: Can devour an Excrescent Carapace to significantly increase its ATK and HP.

the_abandoned.name: 'The Abandoned'
the_abandoned.flavourText: Their consciousness is almost gone. Every nerve strand cries out soundlessly: 'Free... pain...'
abilities: Attacks deal Arts splash damage
Loses splash damage when blocked.

the_cursed.name: 'The Cursed'
the_cursed.flavourText: Their consciousness is fully gone. Every cell remembers the command: 'Dominate... ocean...'
abilities: Attacks deal Arts splash damage
Loses splash damage when blocked.

allotropic_maleficent.name: Allotropic Maleficent
allotropic_maleficent.flavourText: Nucleic Maleficents that have survived in harsh environments, developing glands that produce neurotoxin. Extremely rare, and extremely dangerous.
abilities: Becomes Combat-Ready when damaged, significantly increasing Movement Speed and continuously inflicting Nervous Impairment on nearby units.
Destroys blocking <Excrescent Carapace> at the cost of a percentage of its HP.
